mentions.name: Breakdown
mentions.description: A local Mac menubar utility that provides at-a-glance visibility into live network and application issues, giving fast, reliable answers to questions like why Zoom is lagging, whether the issue is the local WiFi, or what's going on with the Internet. It is free for typical uses and battery-efficient.
mentions.problem: Getting fast answers when applications lag or connectivity breaks, such as determining whether an issue is a specific app, local WiFi, or the wider Internet.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, I built a local Mac utility that runs in the menubar to give at-a-glance visibility into live network and application issues. It's free (for typical uses), battery-efficient, and gives fast and reliable answers.
mentions.author: joelm
